name: opal-api
description: OPAL suite OpenAPI contracts (event, listen, talk) and their validation tooling.

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run lint:opal && npm run lint:look && npm run test:lint && npm run test:event141 && npm run test:think-event && npm run lint:proposals && npm run test:look-vnext
scripts.lint:proposals: spectral lint -r .spectral.yaml openapi/proposals/*.yaml && spectral lint -r .spectral.opal.yaml openapi/proposals/*.yaml
